layer_order.source: osmond332/Spatial_Guided_Self_Supervised_Clustering@592efb6e72ceeef15c8be0630a4673eda5dce6f5 demo_final.py CSNet applies conv -> ReLU -> BN; compatible with the paper's per-layer 'ReLU activation and batch normalisation'

output_normalization.source: osmond332/Spatial_Guided_Self_Supervised_Clustering@592efb6e72ceeef15c8be0630a4673eda5dce6f5 demo_final.py CSNet bn3 normalises the output map; the paper's zero-mean/unit-variance S_hat

context_density.source: paper Eqs. 3-4 transform each cluster into a spatial probability distribution; per-pixel softmax over clusters normalised over pixels is a valid distribution (computed exactly in log space). The official S_hat + 1e-3 shift is not used: on the zero-mean map its weights are signed, so it is not a distribution (OFFICIAL_CODE_FALLBACK rejected as incompatible with the paper).

stopping_rule.source: osmond332/Spatial_Guided_Self_Supervised_Clustering@592efb6e72ceeef15c8be0630a4673eda5dce6f5 demo_final.py --maxIter/--minLabels loop; the paper's 'until stable' gives no criterion
